panels.label: 1. idle startup frame: viewport is pinned to the tail, so no pill is painted
2. /help fills the transcript well past one viewport
3. /hotkeys adds the keybinding table, so the log has real scrollback
5. PgUp detaches the viewport -> the pill appears on the viewport's last row
6. a second PgUp keeps the pill anchored to the bottom of the viewport
7. raw SGR left click on the pill (col 60, row 32) jumps back to the tail; the pill disappears
8. PgUp detaches again, so the pill comes back
